note: Review of DP Instagram item: slogan attributed, not rendered as a factual claim

ops.find: Democratic Party of Albania said in an Instagram post

event.label: alleged
event.text: The opposition Democratic Party of Albania said in an Instagram video that it is "on standby" for the protest, saying that unlike the government it is absent on floods, fires and citizens' hardships; the video's on-screen slogan reads "Rama in prison!". This is the party's own statement.
